description: An anonymised order identifier used to group multiple line items belonging to the same customer order. No original system identifiers are retained.
privacy_notes: Randomised identifier; cannot be traced back to original system

description: Calendar date on which the order was placed.
Day of the week derived from the order date.
Time of day at which the order was placed (24-hour format).
privacy_notes: Time only; no location or personal identifiers

description: Generalised menu category to which the ordered item belongs (e.g., MAIN COURSES, EXTRAS).
Anonymised or generalised menu item name. Specific branding and proprietary names have been removed.
privacy_notes: Menu items generalised; no brand disclosure

description: Number of units of the menu item ordered within the order.
Unit price charged for a single item at the time of order.
Total revenue generated by the line item before costs, calculated as quantity multiplied by unit price.
Estimated cost of goods sold for the line item, calculated using a standard cost ratio for research purposes.
privacy_notes: Cost is estimated; no supplier or invoice data

description: Estimated gross profit for the line item, calculated as gross sales minus estimated cost.
privacy_notes: Derived metric; no financial account references

description: Generalised fulfilment method for the order (e.g., Delivery, Collection).
Generalised payment method used for the order (e.g., Card, Cash).
privacy_notes: Payment method only; no card or transaction details

description: Indicator showing whether the order was cancelled prior to fulfilment.
High-level menu category representing groups of items sold via the EPOS system (e.g., APPETISERS, MAIN COURSES).
Total number of items sold within the category across the full reporting period.
Total gross revenue generated by the category before discounts, taxes, or costs.
Net revenue for the category after discounts and applicable adjustments.
Total value of discounts applied to items within the category during the reporting period.
Total tax or fee amounts associated with category sales, where reported by the EPOS system.
Cost-related or adjustment values reported at category level by the EPOS system (may include cost proxies or internal adjustments).
privacy_notes: Does not reference suppliers or invoices

description: Sales channel identifier indicating the origin of the data (EPOS).
Indicates the level of aggregation applied to the dataset.
Descriptive label indicating the time coverage of the dataset.
High-level menu category used by the EPOS reporting system for grouping sales (e.g., APPETISERS, MAIN COURSES).
privacy_notes: Category-level only; no item names, orders, or customers

description: Total annual sales revenue recorded by the EPOS system for the category in the specified year.
privacy_notes: Aggregated annual revenue; no transaction IDs

description: Proportion of total EPOS annual sales represented by the category (Annual_Sales / Total_Annual_Sales). Values typically between 0 and 1.
privacy_notes: Derived ratio; reduces risk of business identification

description: Calendar year for which the EPOS category totals apply.
Channel identifier for the dataset source (EPOS).
Indicates the aggregation level used for disclosure control and analysis.
UK financial year label for the record (e.g., 2023-24). Derived from calendar year and month using UK FY boundaries (Apr–Mar).
Numeric month of the calendar year (1–12) used for ordering and time-series analysis.
Month name corresponding to Month_Num.
Aggregator platform name representing the revenue source (e.g., JustEat, Deliveroo).
Total revenue for the platform in the given month.
Indicates whether revenue was directly observed or derived/imputed. In this dataset it is typically “Observed”.
UK financial year label for the record (Apr–Mar).
Numeric month (1–12) for ordering and analysis.
Month name corresponding to Month_Num.
Sales channel identifier (e.g., Website, JustEat, Deliveroo).
privacy_notes: Channel label only; no customer IDs

description: Total revenue attributed to the channel for the given month.
Indicates whether the revenue figure is observed or derived.
High-level financial grouping for the line item within the consolidated Profit & Loss statement (e.g., Operating Revenue, Variable Costs, Operating Expenses, Administrative Expenses).
privacy_notes: Aggregated multi-year totals; no transaction-level banking data

description: Specific line-item label within the account category, representing revenue streams or cost groupings.
privacy_notes: No supplier names, customer data, or bank references included

description: Monetary value of the line item in GBP for the full consolidated period. Positive values represent revenue; negative values represent costs or expenses.
privacy_notes: Derived from statutory accounts and bank aggregates; not transaction-level

description: Percentage of total consolidated revenue represented by the line item, calculated as (abs(Value) / Total Revenue) × 100.
Calendar year of delivery, derived from the delivered date and aggregated to monthly totals.
Month name of delivery, derived from the delivered date and used for monthly aggregation.
privacy_notes: Aggregated to month level; no exact dates

description: Generalised menu category for items sold via Deliveroo. Branding and “deal” labels have been scrubbed and normalised.
privacy_notes: Category labels scrubbed to remove brand identifiers

description: Total number of items sold in the category for that month on Deliveroo.
Total gross revenue received for items in the category for that month on Deliveroo.
Sales channel label identifying the platform source of the data.
Indicates the dataset granularity and aggregation level applied for anonymisation.
Descriptive label indicating the coverage period of the dataset.
privacy_notes: Period label only; no sensitive time detail
